findings.text: wiki_read marks a page seen before truncating it, permitting blind replacement. Repro: an in-memory real-route probe with a 60,000-character body and 200-character title returned tailVisible=false, truncated=true, writeAccepted=true; growth between the two GETs did too. Budget the complete framed result and authorize writes only for a fully delivered, unchanged revision. Add boundary and race tests.

base_revision bypasses the promised full-read safeguard: the server accepts a matching revision without checking its read marker. Repro: the in-memory real-route probe read only a 70,004-character page's outline, then wrote using its returned revision: fullGETs=0, withoutBaseRejected=true, withBaseAccepted=true. Require proof that the complete revision was delivered before forwarding base_revision; test outline and section reads followed by writes.

Message framing caps individual bodies but never the total result; read_thread also has no message-count limit. Repro: calling read_thread({message_id:1}) with 50 valid 60,000-character fixture messages returned 3,001,989 characters, truncated=false, isError=false. This permits other actors to exhaust context or cause the client to reject the result. Enforce a total framed-output budget with pagination/continuation and regression tests.

Acceptance 5 is unmet: tests replace the mandated fake-at.ts helper with startTestServer despite the explicit NEEDS_CONTEXT requirement for missing endpoints. Repro: rg -n 'fakeAt|startTestServer' test/plugin/full-api.test.ts returns only startTestServer at 17, 38, 74; fake-at.ts lacks the required wiki/lease routes. Have the orchestrator resolve the shared-helper gap or explicitly amend acceptance, then provide the agreed success, invalid-input and framing coverage.
